about.title: Architecting AI systems that earn trust.
paragraphs: I've spent **20+ years across AI-enabled analytics, payments and enterprise security**, building for both **B2B enterprise and B2C consumer** markets. A hands-on cloud engineering and systems-architecture background lets me evaluate platform trade-offs and win CXO-level buy-in, not just spec features.

My career started in **test and quality**: risk-based test frameworks, automated execution and API-level verification. That shows up today in how I run **AI evaluation, success metrics and production monitoring**: golden datasets, guardrails and pass/fail thresholds before anything goes GA.

Today I'm **Director of Product Management at Qualys**, leading a team of 3 PMs that took its Agentic AI security platform to general availability. We expose agents through MCP, CLI and Slack / Teams, so engineers can use them without opening a dashboard. I also write about Agentic AI and enterprise product strategy, and publish my AI builds on GitHub.

roles.title: Director of Product Management
roles.summary: Leading 3 PMs taking the Agentic AI security suite from pilots to general availability: multi-agent orchestration, tool use and evaluation.
bullets: Lead and coach a team of **3 Product Managers** owning vision and roadmap for the Agentic AI security platform, identifying high-value AI use cases and translating multi-agent and LLM capabilities into a GTM strategy.

Ran **15+ enterprise pilots** in the first two quarters against defined success criteria (agentic flow correctness, result accuracy); CXO-level evangelism converted **40%** into paid proof-of-concepts.
Exposed agentic capabilities through API-first, tool-based surfaces (**Model Context Protocol (MCP), CLI and Slack / Microsoft Teams**), so developers use security agents in their own workflows.
Designed agent action interfaces and tool integrations so agents take real actions, such as exploit validation and remediation orchestration, instead of only answering in a chat.

Built the requirements, evaluation and success metrics framework for multi-agent orchestration (accuracy criteria, response-safety guardrails and pass/fail thresholds) for features that shipped in the **GA release**.

Prioritise the roadmap on strategic fit, user value and business value, refined with **Cost of Delay**; partner with Engineering, Platform, UX and Data Science, cutting feature scoping cycle time by **15%**.
Co-design go-to-market with Sales and Marketing, run **quarterly roadmap reviews** with leadership and Sales, and lead customer calls on product capabilities and fitment.

Architected a computer-vision MVP for a Digital Wellness startup; rapid A/B loops lifted user engagement by **24%** within 6 weeks of launch.
Built **CropGuard**: ambient WhatsApp and voice crop insurance for Indian farmers — parametric drought claims, multilingual channels, and geo-verified field evidence on Express, React and Postgres.

Advised a B2B AgriTech & Crop Insurance platform on the LLM and RAG architecture behind its self-service farmer query product, cutting cost per query by **35%** while scaling to **50K+** queries monthly.
Designed responsible AI compliance protocols aligned to NIST and the EU AI Act, institutionalising a “Trust by Design” framework across 2 client engagements.
